summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to exempt certain rural hospitals from physician self-referral prohibitions and removes the prohibition on expansion for existing physician-owned hospitals.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Social Security Act to revise physician self-referral exemptions for physician-owned hospitals, specifically benefiting rural hospitals and allowing for the expansion of existing physician-owned hospitals. This directly impacts the structure and accessibility of healthcare services, particularly in rural areas, by potentially increasing the number of physician-owned facilities.
